$comment: Image captions for the store screenshots, keyed by screen id: the headline in each locale, the short product label (overline) above it and, for the assistant, the chip that repeats the state its capture shows. compose.mjs reads these; apps/mobile/store/metadata/*.json carries the same headline text for stores that list captions.
